adapter.connect_timeout_ms.basis: Operational bound, not configuration content: no domain meaning and no catalog source (AGENTS.md section 1 rule 1 and section 3 rule 2; docs/SYSTEM.md 5.11). E07 scenario value, set for a station by its operator.

adapter.frame_timeout_ms.basis: Operational bound, not configuration content: no domain meaning and no catalog source (AGENTS.md section 1 rule 1 and section 3 rule 2; docs/SYSTEM.md 5.11). E07 scenario value, set for a station by its operator.

adapter.acquisition_window_ms.basis: Upper bound on one reading: the oximeter procedure takes about 2 minutes (docs/product/ROUTINE.md section 5, team estimate) and its reading counts once it 'stops changing and displays one steady number' (C08, a non-NASA exception in docs/product/NASA-SOURCES.md). No catalog source gives a capture window, so this is an operational bound (docs/SYSTEM.md 5.11), not a clinical timing.

adapter.max_frames.basis: Bound on the frames read in one acquisition (AGENTS.md section 3 rule 2; docs/SYSTEM.md 5.11). The recorded scenario files of this folder hold at most 4 frames, so 4 makes a complete recording use the whole frame budget.

adapter.health_quiet_ms.basis: How long a connected device may stay silent before /health says quiet, an operational bound (docs/SYSTEM.md 5.11) kept equal to the capture window above; no catalog source gives it.
